candidate.prompt: head_swap: start with Picture 1 as the base image, keeping its lighting, environment, and background. remove the head from Picture 1 completely and replace it with the head from Picture 2, strictly preserving the hair, eye color, and nose structure of Picture 2. copy the direction of the eye, head rotation, and micro-expressions from Picture 1. Keep the body, clothing, pose, framing, and background intact. <lora:bfs_head_v1:1.0>
candidate.paste: edit_mask(target, raw) INTERSECTED with the frozen fence; every pixel outside the fence is the target's

baseline.licence: GHOST 1 generator Apache-2.0 per upstream; MediaPipe mask Apache-2.0; identity encoder arcface_w600k_r50 and CrossFace converter are bench-only per docs/identity-studio/LICENCES.md
baseline.fence: the same frozen fence is enforced on the baseline output

fence_recipe: fence = (head-parse mask of the target dilated by 0.25 x face width) UNION (ellipse centred 0.10 x face height above the face-box centre, semi-axes 1.1 x face width and 1.3 x face height), INTERSECTED with probe.head_crop_box(scale 3.4); 1 inside, 0 outside; hash = SHA-256 of the row-major uint8 bytes
scale_method: head span = distance from the eye midpoint to the mouth-corner midpoint (YuNet landmarks), the same definition on target and result
pose_rule: pose_tag from the target's yaw proxy: |yaw| < 0.3 frontal, < 1.0 three_quarter, else profile

identity_methods.sface: SFace fp32 (opencv_zoo), frontal method, preserved if cosine to reference >= 0.363
identity_methods.glintr100: glintr100 (identity bench research judge), profile-capable method, preserved if cosine to reference >= 0.4
